paite: Pethuel tapa Joel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Khaupe In Gam Ahihsiatna

paite: Putekte aw, hiai za un; hiai, nou hun lai leh na pute uh hun lai in a-om kha ngeita a hia?
Huai pen na tate uh hilh unla, na tate un amau tate hilh uhenla, ata nawnte un suan dang hilhsawn zel uhen.
Singnget khaupe in anek bang teng khaukhuphon in ane a, khaukhuphon in anek bang teng khaupehon in ane a; khaupehon in anek bang teng khaupenouhon in ane khinta hi.
Nou zukhamte aw, halh unla kap un; uain dawn tengteng aw, a- uain khum ziak in kap vongvong un; na kam ua kipan lah uain lakmang ahita ngal a.
Nam hat mahmah, sim seng louh in ka gam ahong douta uh, ahate humpinelkai liante ha ahi a, humpinelkai pite hapak anei hi.
Ka grepgui ahihsia a, ka theipi sing hawng akheuh a, akheuhsiang vek a, apaimang a; ahiangte akiatngou vek hi.
Nungak in, sai-ip puan teng a, atuailai pasal asuun bang in kap vongvong un.
Tangbuang latte, dawn ding latte TOUPA' inn a kipan hihman ahi a; siampu TOUPA nasemte alungkham uhi.
Lou hihsiat ahi a, gam alungkham a; buh hihsiat ahi a, uain thak akang a, sathau aginata kei hi.
Aw, nou lounei mite aw, suun unla; aw, nou grepgui kem mite aw, huit buh leh barli buh ziak in dah in mau tuaituai un; lou a buhlak ding amangthang vekta hi.
Grepgui avuai a, theipi kung avuai a; theibuhfai zung, tum leh epul theikung, lou a sing tengteng leng avulta hi; mihing tate lak a kipahna lah avuaimangta ngal a.

Nou siampute aw, sai-ip puan teng unla kap un; nou maitam nasem mite aw, chiau vengvung un; nou ka Pathian nasem mite aw, hong pai unla, sai-ip puan silh in zankhua in hong lum un; na Pathian inn ua pan tangbuang lat leh dawn ding lat lah kham ahita ngal a.
heading: Kisik Ding A Sapna

paite: An ngawl hun tang siangthou in, khawmpi taksuak bawl unla, TOUPA na Pathian inn ah putekte leh hiai gam a teng mi tengteng pikhawm unla, TOUPA sam un.
Huai ni atung agik hi; TOUPA ni lah anai ngal a, Bangkim hihtheipa a kipan manthatna ahong tung ding hi.
Ka mitmuh in nek ding hihman ahi kei a hia, ahi, i nopna leh i kipahna i Pathian inn a kipan hihman ahi kei a hia?
Leikhal nuai ah haichitang amuat a; pangte lah akigawp a, buh innte phel in a-om a, abuhte avuaita uhi.
Gante nak thum hi na tel uh e! Bawnghonte abuaizak ua, loupa hing mun aneih louh ziak un; ahi, belamhonte asegawp uhi.
Aw, TOUPA ka hon sam hi, mei in gamdai gam loupa mun akangsiangta a, meikuang in gam a sing tengteng akangsiangta hi.
Ahi, gamsate nang hon ngai in anak huhu ua; luitate akangtat a, mei in gamdai gam loupa mun akangsiangta hi.
